messages:
Rachel Park: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: canary let two regressions through. We sketched several mitigations yesterday; let's bind owners, deliverables, and short timelines here.
Diego Morales: I can take the auto-rollback piece. Plan: implement a rules engine that evaluates multiple signals (error-rate, p95 latency, user error types) and issues a pause-rollout API call. Prototype by Friday.
Ethan Li: I'll own flag gating and max blast radius. Suggest we require a `max_blast_radius` field on flag creation and enforce initial traffic caps. I'll draft a schema change and a lint rule.
Priya Nair: I'll handle telemetry and recurring-pattern detection. I'll add two scheduled jobs: a daily canary-regression-detector and a weekly pattern-aggregator to catch slow drifts.
Rachel Park: Good. Please post PR links here as you open them. Also we need to add these items to the runbook and set a recurring follow-up for six weeks.
Diego Morales: Implementation detail: the rollback action should be idempotent and not flip flags directly. My prototype will call `/api/flags/<flag>/pause-rollout` which marks the rollout paused and writes an audit event.
Ethan Li: Schema sketch: `flags: { name: string, owner: user, max_blast_radius: float(0,1), initial_fraction: float, ramp_policy: [] }`. I'll add a server-side validation and an infra check to block new flags without `max_blast_radius`.
Priya Nair: For detection queries I'll create saved queries: `canary_error_spike_v2` (alert on 5x baseline within 10m) and `canary_latency_shift` (p95 up 40% sustained). Dashboard + alert routing to #eng-oncall and the responsible owner.
Rachel Park: Ownership matrix: Diego -> rollback (prototype Fri, tests next Tue), Ethan -> flag schema + enforcement (PR by Thu), Priya -> telemetry jobs + dashboards (jobs by Mon). I'll update the postmortem doc and the runbook with this matrix.
ops-bot: Reminder: follow-up meeting "Canary safety remediations" scheduled weekly on Tue 11:00 for 6 weeks.
Diego Morales: One more operational note: prefer pause + investigate for soft triggers. Full rollback for catastrophic failures. We need clear thresholds to avoid flip-flopping.
Ethan Li: I'll add lint error in the flag creation flow with a helpful message: "flags must include max_blast_radius; see docs for recommended values". Also propose a default of 0.02 for experimental flags.
Priya Nair: I'll backfill 30 days of canary telemetry to build baselines so our detectors have better priors and lower false positives.
Rachel Park: Please react with :white_check_mark: after you open the first PR. I'll compile the final ETA table in the postmortem and link the PRs.
Diego Morales: PR opened for rollback prototype: https://git.redwood/ri/guardrails/pulls/210 (WIP).
Ethan Li: PR opened for flag schema + lint: https://git.redwood/ri/flags/pulls/77 (WIP).
Priya Nair: Saved queries + dashboard will be posted in #eng-observability, will ping when ready.
Rachel Park: Final note 1: rotate remediation ownership monthly so recurring patterns get consistent attention. We'll call out primary and backup owners.
Diego Morales: Sounds good.
Ethan Li: Agreed.
Priya Nair: Agreed.
Rachel Park: Thanks team. I'll close out action items in the postmortem doc and follow up in the first weekly meeting."
